checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1390 cards: those quoting NIST publications, US law and the CNCF glossary against their quotes, found word for word by the card checker, and those written in our own words (the ISC2 outline and ethics code, OWASP, Microsoft Learn) against their sources
checks.result: No wrong answers. About 60 cards whose wording was too close to a facts-only source (the ISC2 code, OWASP, STRIDE, GDPR articles) were rewritten in our own words; 20 unsupported claims, 6 ambiguous cards, 10 unclear ones and 60 minor issues were also fixed, and 2 primers re-sourced. Cards citing the GDPR keep a blocker until its reuse terms are confirmed.
